verdict.rationale: Crossplane's Composition model lets a single Composite Resource fan out into many underlying managed resources (docs-13, docs-26), and its declarative Kubernetes-style API (docs-16, docs-20) is inherently amenable to kubectl-style bulk apply/label-selector operations. However, no evidence pack item explicitly describes a bulk-operation feature (e.g., batch create/update/delete across many resources at once), so this is inferred rather than directly demonstrated.
